quick: 20,000 to 100,000 IU depending on site, extent and duration (pharyngeal under 48 h: 20,000 to 40,000; extensive or over 3 days: 80,000 to 100,000)
summary: Diphtheria antitoxin (equine hyperimmune serum) neutralises circulating toxin and must be given as early as possible in suspected diphtheria, without waiting for culture. In the Indian brand catalogue 'diphtheria immune globulin' paired with Hib usually denotes the diphtheria carrier protein of the Hib conjugate vaccine instead.

dosage.d: 20,000 to 100,000 IU depending on site, extent and duration (pharyngeal under 48 h: 20,000 to 40,000; extensive or over 3 days: 80,000 to 100,000)
dosage.n: Test for horse-serum sensitivity per protocol; have adrenaline ready

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Neutralises unbound diphtheria toxin; does not affect toxin already in cells.

absolute: None absolute in confirmed diphtheria; desensitise if test positive

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
monitoring: Cardiac monitoring (myocarditis risk from the disease)
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
pearls: Give antibiotics (erythromycin or penicillin) as well; notify public health
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
